seo.title: Pomo Easy — Pomodoro Timer with Live Activities
seo.description: A focused Pomodoro timer for iOS. Classic 25/5 technique, customizable intervals, Live Activities, Focus Mode, and session stats. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: POMODORO TIMER
hero.title: Focus made easy.
text: A purpose-built Pomodoro timer with Live Activities. Classic 25/5 technique, customizable intervals, and Focus Mode integration.

items.title: Classic 25/5
items.text: The proven Pomodoro Technique: 25 minutes of focused work, 5 minutes of rest. Four cycles, then a longer break.

items.title: Customizable Intervals
items.text: Adjust work and break durations to match your rhythm. Create the perfect focus session for how you work best.

items.title: Live Activities
items.text: See your timer on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Stay focused without unlocking your phone.

items.title: Focus Mode
items.text: Automatically enable iOS Focus Mode during work sessions. Silence distractions without lifting a finger.

items.title: Session Stats
items.text: Track completed pomodoros, total focus time, and daily streaks. Build the consistency that drives productivity.

items.title: Completely Offline
items.text: No servers, no cloud sync, no network requests. Your focus data stays on your device. Period.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Pomo Easy doesn't even make network requests. Your session data lives on your device and nowhere else.

cta.title: Start focusing.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
